_comment: Physical ring: the 3 FCOB strips form one closed 1920px loop.
beginning of board1 touches end of board3; beginning of board3 touches
end of board2; beginning of board2 touches end of board1.
ring_offset is optional (derived from order) but checked if present;
length must match pixel_count in nodes.json; total ring length is
derived. To add a 4th board: add it to nodes.json, append a segment
here at the position where it sits in the loop.
